svg.title: Wallet and Premium Fee Math Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-wallet-fee-math-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Wallet and Premium Fee Math Roadmap; subtitle: Pay-in-full floor, catch-all core, fee audits and rule-change rebuilds; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Pay-in-Full Floor; deliverable: Autopay set to clear every statement; every 0% window mapped to a payoff date.; gate: Full balance paid before any 0% window closes; 18 to 25 percent APR wipes out rewards (Fat Stacks Academy).; week: Week 2; title: Catch-All Core Plus Specialists; deliverable: A 2x or 2% catch-all wrapped by category cards, close to 3% blended (Rob Berger).; gate: Blue Cash Preferred only if supermarket spend tops about $264 a month (Dutcher Capital).; week: Week 3; title: Premium Fee Audit; deliverable: Gold scored at +$199 vs -$85 and Platinum at +$1,000 vs -$715 by credit capture.; gate: Count only credits that replace existing spend (Card & Capital, Leo's Travel Hacks).; week: Week 4; title: Rule-Change Rebuild; deliverable: Hotel credit plans rebuilt around the FHR 2-night minimum from January 1, 2027.; gate: Gold opened before Platinum because of Amex family language (Ben Hedges, Leo's Travel Hacks).; caption: Fee math is a utilization test; Fat Stacks Academy layered a 0% APR float on the Blue Business Plus for $926.66 profit on $12,282.88 of spend.; assumptions note: Week sequencing is an organizing frame; every figure is as reported by the named practitioner, and the $861.34 figure reflects a 15% tax set-aside.; note: Sources - Fat Stacks Academy, Rob Berger, Dutcher Capital, Leo's Travel Hacks, Card & Capital, Ben Hedges.
